mechanisms.label: European strategic autonomy
mechanisms.summary: The only candidate that directly supports the European strategic autonomy mechanism is the procurement of counter‑drone software for Dutch Skyranger vehicles from the Norwegian company Kongsberg. This represents a European government (the Netherlands) sourcing a critical capability from a European supplier, thereby reducing dependence on non‑European vendors.
